rationale: Primary evidence has not yet repeated on a future/fresh window.
clearance_condition: Pass on at least one future/fresh window for continued research; prefer two independent fresh confirmations before rewrite spec.
fresh_window_test: Repeat Stage 6B replay/readback on a fresh window and compare primary against the baseline clean boxed arm.

rationale: March concentration warning remains a live-design blocker until fresh repeat exists.
clearance_condition: At least one non-March fresh window, preferably two.
fresh_window_test: Carry window/state concentration flags into the fresh run and require the finding to survive outside the March window.

rationale: Support-on is not validated as a broad positive modifier.
clearance_condition: Must pass narrowed-bucket evidence before entering any scoring rewrite.
fresh_window_test: Retest support-on only as a narrower paired modifier, never as broad positive expansion.

rationale: Hard restraint exclusion cannot be promoted before soft-penalty calibration.
clearance_condition: Soft-penalty workbench must show stable calibration before rewrite design.
fresh_window_test: Convert hard-exclusion evidence into soft-penalty simulations and test whether high-pressure rows can be downweighted without losing useful conversions.

rationale: Duplicate-credit guardrail must pass on every replay.
fresh_window_test: Verify union replay never double-counts primary and secondary lineage-supported rows.

rationale: Decay must remain companion-only and separate from spend evidence.
clearance_condition: Boundary must remain explicit in every fresh-window readback.
